claims.statement: DORA became applicable on 17 January 2025 and requires in-scope financial entities to maintain a comprehensive register of ICT third-party contractual arrangements at relevant consolidation levels.
Adopted implementing technical standards define register templates that competent authorities and the ESAs use for supervision and critical-provider designation.

contrary_evidence: Governance, risk, and contract-lifecycle suites already target DORA.
Some smaller financial entities may outsource the whole task as annual consulting.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: a provenance-linked clause and validation corpus covering recurrent register defects
fingerprint.customer: small EU insurers, payment firms, investment firms, credit unions, and compliance outsourcers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: DORA consultancies, managed-service providers, legal firms, and core-platform implementers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: contract extraction, controlled taxonomy, graph reconciliation, evidence lineage, validation, and regulator-format exports
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the regulated entity pays for implementation and continuous register maintenance
fingerprint.problem_trigger: an ICT contract, subcontractor, entity perimeter, critical function, or regulator submission changes

founder_fit: Good fit for knowledge graphs, document AI, validation, and low-social partner distribution; a Polish payments or insurance niche permits bounded entry.
risks: Extraction errors can propagate into regulatory submissions.
Financial-sector security and audit requirements raise delivery cost.
The product must preserve accountable human approval.

structure.control_point: the quality-checked DORA Register of Information submission dataset and cell-level provenance
structure.critical_dependency: complete contract inventories and accurate provider, subcontractor, entity, and critical-function hierarchies

thesis: A contract-ingestion graph can reconcile ICT services, entities, functions, subcontractors, identifiers, exit terms, and amendments into the DORA Register of Information format and keep evidence attached to every cell. Specialist compliance firms and MSPs can distribute it across portfolios; every vendor or contract change reopens the workflow.
title: DORA Contract-to-Register Evidence Graph for Small Financial Entities
uncertainties: Minimum viable customer segment under exemptions.
